svg.title: The compressor
svg.desc: The compressor reads s, the 100-number context of each event from the frozen forecasting encoder, puts it on a benign scale fitted once on 200,000 benign training events, and passes it through an autoencoder: LayerNorm, Linear 100 to 128, ReLU, Linear 128 to 32 gives z; The decoder, Linear 32 to 128, ReLU, Linear 128 to 100, rebuilds s. Each event is encoded on its own, in batches of 512 events in availability order. It is trained on benign events only to minimise the mean squared rebuild error; The best epoch has the lowest validation loss. It writes z, which the world model reads, and the reconstruction error, which is for reports only and is never an input to the world model.
